scripts.hint: Rayo finds a shell that whispers a secret on the beach.
lines: Rayo: What is that shiny thing hiding in the sand?
Rayo: I found a magic shell on the beach today!
Teddy: Come and listen, Rayo — the shell is whispering!
Rayo: It says there is a secret under the big rock.
Rayo: I drive slowly, so I do not wake the sleepy crabs.
Teddy: The waves are tickling my feet, Rayo!
Rayo: Look, Teddy! A tiny starfish is waving at us.
Teddy: The shell whispers again — turn left at the pink coral!
Rayo: I follow the sound, my engine humming a happy song.
Rayo: Oh no! A big wave splashes my shiny red nose!
Teddy: Wait, Rayo... behind the wave, a little turtle is stuck!
Rayo: Hold on, little turtle! I will push you back to the sea.
Teddy: Hooray! The turtle swims away, free and happy!
Rayo: The shell whispers one last secret — thank you, Rayo!
Rayo: I place the shell back where the sea can hear it.
Teddy: The sun is painting the sky orange, Rayo!
Rayo: Today was full of surprises, Teddy!
Rayo: I am the fastest car on the beach, and the kindest too.
Teddy: Goodbye, sea! We will keep your secret safe.
Rayo: Tomorrow I will race the rain clouds — will you come with me?
scripts.title: Rayo and the Whispering Shell

scripts.hint: Rayo races the rain and rescues a lost kitten.
lines: Rayo: Why is the sky rumbling like a sleepy giant?
Rayo: Today the rain is my racetrack!
Rayo: Teddy, put on your little yellow raincoat!
Teddy: Splash! Your wheels make rainbows in every puddle!
Rayo: The raindrops dance on my roof like tiny drums.
Rayo: I zoom past the red mailbox, water flying behind me.
Teddy: Look, Rayo! The ducks are having a swimming race too!
Rayo: I slow down near the old oak tree, its leaves dripping.
Teddy: A rainbow is starting to grow in the grey sky!
Rayo: Oh no! My lightning bolt is getting all wet!
Teddy: Wait, Rayo... who is that hiding under the bus stop?
Rayo: It is a little lost kitten, shivering in the rain!
Rayo: Hop in, kitten! Teddy will keep you warm and dry.
Teddy: The kitten is purring, Rayo! She feels safe now.
Rayo: Her owner waves and says thank you, Rayo!
Teddy: The clouds opened up, and the sun is smiling!
Rayo: Teddy and I splash through one last giant puddle.
Rayo: Rainy days are the best days for a brave little car!
Teddy: Goodbye, rainbow! We will see you again soon.
Rayo: Tomorrow I will explore the whispering forest — will you come with me?
scripts.title: Rayo and the Rainy Day Race

scripts.hint: Rayo drives into a whispering forest and helps a hedgehog.
lines: Rayo: Who is calling my name from between the tall trees?
Rayo: Today I drive into the whispering forest!
Rayo: Teddy, hold my mirror tight — the path is bumpy!
Teddy: The leaves above us make a green roof of shade!
Rayo: I roll over soft moss, quiet as a secret.
Teddy: A squirrel dropped an acorn on your hood, Rayo!
Rayo: Look, Teddy! Mushrooms glow like tiny lamps.
Teddy: The forest smells of rain and sweet pine needles.
Rayo: I follow a trail of golden leaves, deeper and deeper.
Rayo: Oh no! A fallen branch blocks the narrow path!
Teddy: Wait, Rayo... the branch is moving! It is a sleepy hedgehog!
Rayo: Careful, little hedgehog — I will help you cross.
Teddy: The hedgehog waddled into the bushes, waving goodbye!
Rayo: Behind the branch, I find a hidden wooden bridge!
Rayo: I cross the bridge slowly, the stream singing below.
Teddy: Fireflies woke up to light our way home!
Rayo: The forest sings us a goodnight song, Teddy.
Rayo: I am the bravest little car in the whole forest!
Teddy: Goodbye, tall trees! We will visit you again soon.
Rayo: Tomorrow I will climb the snowy mountain road — will you come with me?
scripts.title: Rayo and the Whispering Forest

scripts.hint: Rayo climbs a snowy mountain road with help from a goat.
lines: Rayo: Why is everything outside suddenly white and sparkly?
Rayo: Today I climb the snowy mountain road!
Rayo: Teddy, wear your warmest scarf — it is freezing!
Teddy: Your wheels are crunching the fresh snow, Rayo!
Rayo: Snowflakes land on my windshield like tiny stars.
Rayo: I drive past pine trees dressed in white coats.
Teddy: Look, Rayo! A snowman is waving at us from the hill!
Rayo: I beep my horn, and the snowman tips his carrot hat.
Rayo: The road twists up, up, up to the very top.
Rayo: Oh no! My wheels are slipping on the icy bend!
Teddy: Wait, Rayo... a friendly mountain goat is blocking the way!
Rayo: Hello, goat! Can you show me the safe path down?
Rayo: The goat trots ahead, and I follow her careful steps.
Teddy: At the top, the whole valley is shining below us!
Rayo: Teddy and I build a tiny snow car beside the road.
Rayo: The sun melts the ice, and my wheels grip again.
Teddy: We are sliding gently down, laughing all the way!
Rayo: Snowy roads are scary, but friends make them fun!
Teddy: Goodbye, snowy mountain! We will be back soon.
Rayo: Tomorrow I will race across the hot desert — will you come with me?
scripts.title: Rayo and the Snowy Mountain Road

scripts.hint: Rayo finds a glowing treasure chest in the desert.
lines: Rayo: What is that golden sparkle far across the sand?
Rayo: Today I race across the hot desert!
Rayo: Teddy, bring the water bottle — the sun is strong!
Teddy: Your wheels leave wavy lines on the soft dunes!
Rayo: A cactus waves at us like a green desert guard.
Rayo: I zoom past a sleepy lizard sunbathing on a rock.
Teddy: Look, Rayo! The sand is as gold as my fur!
Rayo: A warm wind sings through the tall dunes.
Rayo: I follow the sparkle, my engine purring in the heat.
Rayo: Oh no! A sandstorm is rolling towards us!
Teddy: Wait, Rayo... inside the storm, something is glowing blue!
Rayo: It is an old treasure chest, buried in the sand!
Teddy: The chest is full of shiny marbles, Rayo!
Rayo: We share the marbles with a little desert fox.
Teddy: The fox is showing us a secret oasis!
Rayo: Cool water splashes my hot wheels — what a relief!
Teddy: Palm trees are shading us as we rest by the pool.
Rayo: The desert is hot, but kindness makes it cool!
Rayo: I drive home as the sun sets behind the dunes.
Rayo: Tomorrow I will drive through the starry night — will you come with me?
scripts.title: Rayo and the Desert Treasure

scripts.hint: Rayo drives under the stars, guided by fireflies.
lines: Rayo: Why are the stars blinking at me tonight?
Rayo: Tonight I drive under the starry sky!
Rayo: Teddy, switch on my headlights — it is dark out there!
Teddy: Your lights make two golden tunnels on the road!
Rayo: The moon follows us like a big silver balloon.
Rayo: I roll past houses with warm yellow windows.
Teddy: Look, Rayo! An owl is hooting from the old chimney!
Rayo: The night air smells sweet, like sleepy flowers.
Rayo: I drive slowly, listening to the crickets sing.
Rayo: Oh no! My headlights flicker — did I run out of power?
Teddy: Wait, Rayo... a firefly cloud is glowing ahead of us!
Rayo: The fireflies light the road brighter than my lamps!
Teddy: We are following a glowing river of light, Rayo!
Rayo: The fireflies lead us to a field of night-blooming flowers!
Teddy: The flowers opened just for us, soft and white!
Rayo: I thank the fireflies, and they dance around my roof.
Rayo: We drive home under a sky full of twinkling stars.
Teddy: Night drives are magic when friends light the way!
Rayo: I park under the window and dream of the stars.
Rayo: Tomorrow I will visit the busy toy market — will you come with me?
scripts.title: Rayo and the Starry Night Drive

scripts.hint: Rayo visits a toy market and dances with a robot.
lines: Rayo: What is that cheerful music coming from the market?
Rayo: Today I visit the busy toy market!
Rayo: Teddy, hold on tight — there are toys everywhere!
Teddy: Balloons float above the stalls like colourful clouds!
Rayo: I roll past a stall selling tiny wooden trains.
Rayo: A wind-up duck waddles right in front of my wheels!
Teddy: Look, Rayo! A teddy bear stall — just like me!
Rayo: The toy seller waves and offers us a shiny bell.
Rayo: I beep happily, and the bell rings back at me.
Rayo: Oh no! A runaway toy robot is rolling towards us!
Teddy: Wait, Rayo... the robot is not broken — it is dancing!
Rayo: Teddy claps as the robot spins and flashes its lights.
Rayo: We join the dance, my wheels tapping to the music.
Teddy: The robot gave us a golden star as a prize!
Rayo: We stick the star on my hood — I am a star car now!
Teddy: The market lights are twinkling as the evening comes.
Rayo: Teddy and I wave goodbye to all our new toy friends.
Rayo: The toy market is the happiest place in town!
Teddy: Goodbye, toy market! We will visit again soon.
Rayo: Tomorrow I will cross the old river bridge — will you come with me?
scripts.title: Rayo and the Busy Toy Market

scripts.hint: Rayo helps a beaver fix the old river bridge.
lines: Rayo: Why is the old bridge creaking in the morning wind?
Rayo: Today I cross the old river bridge!
Rayo: Teddy, look down — the river is sparkling below us!
Teddy: The wooden planks go one by one under your wheels!
Rayo: Ducks swim under the bridge, quacking a hello.
Rayo: My wheels rumble softly on the old brown wood.
Teddy: Look, Rayo! A fish jumps right out of the water!
Rayo: The river bends around green hills and tall reeds.
Rayo: I stop in the middle to watch the boats go by.
Rayo: Oh no! A loose plank is wobbling under my wheels!
Teddy: Wait, Rayo... a beaver is fixing the bridge with sticks!
Rayo: Hello, beaver! Can I help you carry the wood?
Teddy: We are pushing the planks while the beaver hammers!
Rayo: The bridge is strong again — thank you, beaver friend!
Rayo: We cross together, the beaver riding on my roof.
Teddy: Wildflowers cover the whole field on the other side!
Rayo: The beaver waves goodbye and dives into the river.
Rayo: Old bridges are safer when friends fix them together!
Teddy: Goodbye, river! We will cross again soon.
Rayo: Tomorrow I will climb the misty mountain road — will you come with me?
scripts.title: Rayo and the Old River Bridge

scripts.hint: Rayo climbs a foggy mountain road, guided by a goat's bell.
lines: Rayo: Why is the mountain hiding behind a white cloud?
Rayo: Today I climb the misty mountain road!
Rayo: Teddy, the fog is thick — stay close to me!
Teddy: Your headlights cut through the soft white mist!
Rayo: Pine trees appear and disappear like ghosts.
Rayo: I climb slowly, my engine humming a brave tune.
Teddy: Look, Rayo! A mountain eagle is soaring above us!
Rayo: The eagle circles down and lands on a tall rock.
Rayo: I follow the eagle's path around the steep bends.
Rayo: Oh no! The fog is so thick I cannot see the road!
Teddy: Wait, Rayo... a tiny mountain bell is ringing somewhere!
Rayo: It is a little goat with a bell, showing us the way!
Teddy: The goat is trotting ahead, and we follow her!
Rayo: The fog lifts, and the whole valley opens below!
Rayo: Waterfalls sparkle on the cliffs all around us.
Teddy: The goat led us to a sunny meadow full of flowers!
Rayo: We rest in the meadow, eating sweet mountain berries.
Rayo: Misty mountains are less scary with a friend to guide you!
Teddy: Goodbye, misty mountain! We will climb again soon.
Rayo: Tomorrow I will visit the blooming flower garden — will you come with me?
scripts.title: Rayo and the Misty Mountain Road

scripts.hint: Rayo helps water the flowers in a blooming garden.
lines: Rayo: What smells so sweet on the morning breeze?
Rayo: Today I visit the blooming flower garden!
Rayo: Teddy, look at all the colours — red, yellow, pink!
Teddy: We are driving past tall sunflowers, Rayo!
Rayo: Bees buzz from flower to flower, busy as can be.
Rayo: A butterfly lands on my mirror and waves its wings.
Teddy: Look, Rayo! The roses are as big as dinner plates!
Rayo: I roll slowly so I do not squash a single petal.
Rayo: The garden smells like honey and fresh rain.
Rayo: Oh no! A thirsty little sprout is drooping in the sun!
Teddy: Wait, Rayo... the old gardener is carrying a watering can!
Rayo: Hello, gardener! Can I help you water the flowers?
Teddy: I will hold the hose while you pull the little cart!
Rayo: Water sparkles on the petals, and the sprout stands up tall!
Teddy: The gardener gave us a basket of strawberries!
Rayo: We share the strawberries with the bees and butterflies.
Rayo: The garden glows gold as the afternoon sun shines.
Teddy: Flower gardens are happiest when everyone helps!
Rayo: I drive home with a daisy tucked behind my mirror.
Rayo: Tomorrow I will return to the whispering beach — will you come with me?
scripts.title: Rayo and the Blooming Flower Garden
Rayo and the Frozen Ice Lake
scripts.hint: Rayo drives to a frozen lake, where skaters glide and a little penguin needs help.
lines: Rayo: Why is the little lake sparkling like a giant mirror?
Rayo: Today I drive to the frozen ice lake!
Teddy: Wear your cosy earmuffs, Rayo — the wind is chilly!
Rayo: My wheels crunch over the frosty path to the shore.
Teddy: The ducks are sliding across the ice like skaters!
Rayo: A red-breasted robin sings from a frosty branch.
Teddy: The ice is as smooth as a skating rink, Rayo!
Rayo: I drive slowly around the edge, watching the skaters glide.
Rayo: Snow is falling softly, dusting my roof white.
Rayo: Oh no! A little penguin slipped and is sliding towards the hole!
Teddy: Wait, Rayo... the penguin is stuck on a wobbly ice floe!
Rayo: Hold on, little penguin! I will pull you back with my rope!
Teddy: The penguin waddles onto my lap, safe and giggling!
Rayo: The penguin's friends slide over to say thank you!
Teddy: We build a tiny snow slide for the penguins to play on!
Rayo: The setting sun turns the ice pink and gold.
Teddy: The penguins wave goodbye as we drive home!
Rayo: Frozen lakes are cold, but helping friends warms my heart!
Teddy: Goodbye, icy lake! We will skate again soon.
Rayo: Tomorrow I will visit the friendly farmyard — will you come with me?

scripts.title: Rayo and the Friendly Farmyard
scripts.hint: Rayo visits a farm full of animals and helps a lost little lamb find her mother.
lines: Rayo: Who is crowing so loudly at the crack of dawn?
Rayo: Today I visit the friendly farmyard!
Teddy: Watch out for the hens, Rayo — they are crossing the road!
Rayo: A big red rooster struts past my front wheels.
Teddy: The cows are mooing a morning song in the meadow!
Rayo: I roll past golden haystacks, tall as little houses.
Teddy: Look, Rayo! A piglet is rolling in a muddy puddle!
Rayo: The farmer waves and tosses me a shiny red apple.
Rayo: I munch the apple, my engine humming happily.
Rayo: Oh no! A little lamb has wandered off from the flock!
Teddy: Wait, Rayo... the lamb is hiding behind the big barn!
Rayo: Come here, little lamb! Your mother is calling for you!
Teddy: The lamb hops back to her mother, bleating with joy!
Rayo: The farmer gives us a basket of fresh warm eggs!
Teddy: We share the eggs with the hens — everyone gets a treat!
Rayo: The sun is setting, and the farm smells of fresh hay.
Teddy: The animals wave goodbye as we drive home!
Rayo: Farms are full of friends, big and small!
Teddy: Goodbye, farmyard! We will visit again soon.
Rayo: Tomorrow I will drive to the little lighthouse — will you come with me?

scripts.title: Rayo and the Little Lighthouse
scripts.hint: Rayo drives to a lighthouse on a rocky cliff and helps light the lamp for a lost boat.
lines: Rayo: What is that bright beam sweeping across the sea?
Rayo: Today I drive to the little lighthouse!
Teddy: Hold my scarf, Rayo — the sea wind is strong!
Rayo: My wheels bump along the rocky cliff path.
Teddy: Seagulls circle above us, crying a salty hello!
Rayo: The lighthouse stands tall, striped red and white.
Teddy: Look, Rayo! A sailboat is bobbing on the waves below!
Rayo: The keeper waves from the top and invites us in!
Rayo: I climb the winding stairs, my headlights lighting the way.
Rayo: Oh no! The big lamp has gone dark in the fog!
Teddy: Wait, Rayo... a little boat is lost in the mist!
Rayo: Quick, keeper! We must light the lamp again!
Teddy: My headlights shine while the keeper fixes the bulb!
Rayo: The lamp glows again, guiding the little boat home!
Teddy: The sailors wave and blow their horn in thanks!
Rayo: The sunset paints the sea in pink and gold.
Teddy: We watch the lighthouse beam dance across the waves!
Rayo: A lighthouse is a friend that never stops shining!
Teddy: Goodbye, lighthouse! We will sail back soon.
Rayo: Tomorrow I will float up at the balloon festival — will you come with me?

scripts.title: Rayo and the Hot Air Balloon Festival
scripts.hint: Rayo visits a balloon festival in a green field and rescues a little balloon puppy that floated away.
lines: Rayo: What are those giant colourful bubbles floating in the sky?
Rayo: Today I visit the hot air balloon festival!
Teddy: Look up, Rayo — a balloon shaped like a giant bee!
Rayo: My wheels roll over the soft green festival field.
Teddy: The balloons glow like lanterns in the morning light!
Rayo: A little girl waves from a basket high above us!
Teddy: The balloon pilots are filling the balloons with hot air!
Rayo: I beep hello, and a striped balloon bobs down to me!
Rayo: The wind is gentle, perfect for a sky adventure!
Rayo: Oh no! A little balloon puppy has floated away on its string!
Teddy: Wait, Rayo... the puppy balloon is tangled in a tall tree!
Rayo: Quick, Teddy! Pull the string before it floats away!
Teddy: I caught the string, Rayo! The balloon puppy is safe!
Rayo: The pilot ties it tight, and the children cheer!
Teddy: We get a ride in a real balloon basket, high in the sky!
Rayo: The whole town looks tiny below us, like a toy set!
Teddy: We float gently down as the evening stars appear!
Rayo: Balloon days are the highest adventures of all!
Teddy: Goodbye, balloon festival! We will float again soon.
Rayo: Tomorrow I will bake at the cozy bakery — will you come with me?

scripts.title: Rayo and the Cozy Bakery
scripts.hint: Rayo visits a cozy bakery smelling of cinnamon, and a hungry little mouse nibbles the birthday cake.
lines: Rayo: What is that yummy smell drifting down the street?
Rayo: Today I visit the cozy little bakery!
Teddy: My tummy is rumbling, Rayo — it smells like cinnamon!
Rayo: Warm bread is cooling on the windowsill, golden and round.
Teddy: The baker waves floury hands and says hello!
Rayo: I roll up to the counter, my wheels squeaking softly.
Teddy: Look, Rayo! Cupcakes with pink icing, just like flowers!
Rayo: The baker lets us stir the big bowl of cake batter!
Rayo: I wiggle my wheels, mixing the batter round and round!
Rayo: Oh no! A little mouse has nibbled the birthday cake!
Teddy: Wait, Rayo... the mouse is just hungry, not naughty!
Rayo: Here, little mouse! Have a warm roll of your own!
Teddy: The mouse nibbles happily and squeaks a tiny thank you!
Rayo: The baker bakes a fresh cake, even bigger than before!
Teddy: We decorate it with strawberries and swirls of cream!
Rayo: The birthday child smiles and shares the cake with everyone!
Teddy: We drive home with a warm bun for the road!
Rayo: A bakery is the warmest place on a cold day!
Teddy: Goodbye, cozy bakery! We will bake again soon.
Rayo: Tomorrow I will chase the autumn leaves in the park — will you come with me?
